paper.title: Algorithm 801: POLSYS_PLP: A partitioned linear product homotopy code for solving polynomial systems of equations

stack: Fortran 90 (TOMS 801 archive: Fortran90/Dp/Src/polsys_plp.f90, lapack_plp.f; Fortran90/Dp/Drivers/main_template.f90, INPUT.DAT, OUTPUT.DAT)

claim.text: TWO QUADRICS real finite solution (first INPUT.DAT problem, TRACKTOL 1e-4, FINALTOL 1e-14, seed 32749): Re X(2) = -0.788344824094120 as printed in the shipped OUTPUT.DAT, absolute tolerance 1e-6.

values.name: TWO QUADRICS real finite solution, Re X(2)

attempt: Reproduced with a build-only toolchain change. The authors' README build with the latest gfortran (13) fails: polsys_plp.f90 is rejected ("Index variable 'iter' redefined"), so the original attempt failed; -std=legacy does not lift it. The same unedited sources, built out of tree with gfortran 9.5 (-O0, README flags, no source or flag change to the code), compile and link. Three manifests prove no source file was touched (verify_sources record: build-only, nothing modified/removed/added). The archive's INPUT.DAT runs through main_template: the first real finite solution (X(1) = 2.34233851959128E+03) has X(2) real part -7.88344824094139E-01 in pass 1 (-O0), identical in pass 2 (-O2, separate tree). Difference from the shipped value is 1.9e-15, far inside 1e-6.

original_attempt.reason: gfortran 13: polsys_plp.f90 fails with "Index variable 'iter' redefined at (1) in procedure 'root_plp' called from within DO loop at (2)" (ITER is modified inside ROOT_PLP while a caller DO loop uses it); lapack_plp.f compiles with warnings only. -std=legacy does not lift the error.
